name: real-time-cryptocurrency-trading
description: Real-time simulated cryptocurrency trading web application

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @crypto/protocol && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @crypto/api" "npm run dev -w @crypto/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @crypto/protocol && npm run dev -w @crypto/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crypto/protocol && npm run build -w @crypto/api && npm run build -w @crypto/web
